title: Peptides+: Supporting Clinically Guided Care, From the Inside Out
summary: Today, Hers launched Peptides+, our newest specialty built around supporting goals for energy, recovery, and healthy aging.
body_markdown:
As an OB-GYN, I hear the same thing from women every week. They’ve invested time and money in supplements, skincare, and wellness routines. What they want is for that effort to show up in how they look and feel, with steady energy, a clear head, and confidence that they’re aging well.


In a recent survey commissioned by Hers of more than 2,000 U.S. adults, including 1,000 women, at least 1 in 3 of the women respondents in every age group said they’re lacking energy, and at least 1 in 3 said they’re lacking sleep. When even the best routines leave women feeling like they’re on empty, it’s natural they look for something to build on the work they’re already doing. As a result, many women are curious about peptides.


Peptides have gone from trending topics on social media, to one of the most popular conversations I have with women in the exam room. Unfortunately, there’s a significant knowledge and trust gap, and our recent survey shows where women are getting their information. Among adult respondents who’ve heard of peptides, more learned about them from TikTok or social media influencers (25%) than from their doctor (20%).¹ Too often, that leaves women spending more time and money on unregulated sellers and over-the-counter products.


As Chief Medical Officer of Hers, my job is to help women make informed decisions about their health. They deserve clarity on how a treatment works, what the research shows, and what we’re still learning – all under the guidance of an experienced clinician.


That’s why we’re launching[Peptides+](https://www.forhers.com/peptides-plus) , a clinically guided specialty designed to support health at the cellular level. Peptides+ connects eligible women with independent, licensed providers who can prescribe individualized care plans anchored in their health history and goals, starting with five foundational treatments that target the body from the inside out.


{inline-gallery}


Peptides are short chains of amino acids that cells use to send signals to one another. Peptides+ includes peptides with other well-known compounds the body relies on. The compounded treatments in Peptides+ contain the below active ingredients:


- **NAD+** is a coenzyme that helps cells produce energy and repair DNA. Natural levels tend to decline with age.
- **Vitamin B12** supports energy production, red blood cell formation, and brain and nervous system health. Low levels can cause fatigue, weakness, and brain fog in people who are deficient.
- **Glutathione** is a naturally occurring antioxidant that supports the body’s cellular defenses against oxidative stress.
- **Sermorelin** is a peptide that supports the body’s own growth hormone signaling, which plays a role in muscle, metabolism, and recovery.
- **L-carnitine** is made from amino acids and supports cellular energy function and how the body uses fat for fuel.


The journey begins with an intake on a woman’s health history, current medications and goals. An independent, licensed provider trained in peptide therapies then determines whether she’s eligible and which treatment and dosage, if any, makes sense for her. Treatments are compounded in the U.S. and dispensed by U.S. licensed pharmacies.


Peptides+ is available with Care+, which pairs treatment with comprehensive insights and support experience. Customers receive an at-home lab kit and access to lab testing twice a year to track their progress, unlimited support and ongoing check-ins from a dedicated Care Team, and the option to message providers trained in peptide therapy 24/7 with any questions. To give customers and their providers a baseline from day one, without an office visit, Care+ gives women access to the Hers Women’s Panel, an at-home kit for lab testing. It is the first time Hers is offering at-home blood collection for women, providing insights across 22 biomarkers including, hormones, vitamins, heart health and more.


Women have spent years doing the work and finding their own answers. Peptides+ is designed to support that journey, with a clinical team that stays involved, provides clear information on what each treatment does, and develops a plan that moves with them through every stage of life and can change as often as she does.
